inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: The news from the Middle East tensions with the US, Israel, and Iran is deeply troubling, as the Americans have gone ahead and offered this 15-point ceasefire plan to the Iranians through Pakistan. Iran has predictably responded by demanding five counter-conditions, including an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is absolutely right to stay skeptical and stand firm on their right to pre-emptive strikes to defend their nation and people. This only proves the urgent need for real strength and resolve from our side, rather than these endless talks that encourage our enemies and undermine traditional allies who put security and order first.
